name: Vivid Activity
description: Redraws agent thinking and tool-call rows as color-coded activity rows with live states, folds finished runs into one summary row with its file changes and turn tokens, and times every step. English and Simplified Chinese, plus user-defined languages.

zh-CN.name: 彩色活动行
zh-CN.description: 把 Agent 的思考行和工具调用行重绘成按颜色区分、带实时状态的活动行，把跑完的一段折叠成一行摘要并附上文件改动和本轮 Token，还为每一步计时。支持英文、简体中文和用户自定义语言。
